title: CMTC | Workload Security

panels.title: Native authenticated-only trial — no application-port list

options.content:
**Native panels: isolated cmtc-mtls fixture only.** The Cluster selector affects planned CMTC panels below. **Planned panels: not implemented; No data is expected until their stories land.**

**Two nodes · no application sidecars · no CNP / CCNP / KNP.** Native authentication checks reject an absent verified TLS principal, without an application-port list.

**Locally tested paths:** mTLS on 80 / 8080 / 9443 and Service 18080 → 8080; unenrolled and host clients receive no HTTP response. Independent request and restart-probe results belong to the recorded run; the panels show the selected time range.

**Open gates:** effective workload authorization, creation/restore capture, platform exceptions, cross-cluster and transport composition. **Complete Protected status is not claimed.**

panels.description: Experimental scope, demonstrated paths and explicit remaining security gates.

panels.description: Percent of destination-reported completed TCP attempts in the selected time range, using increase(istio_tcp_connections_closed_total). Each connection belongs to exactly one category; source reports are excluded to prevent double counting. No failure flag does not prove HTTP success. Excludes in-flight connections and early failures without a completed TCP record. These are TCP connections, not HTTP requests or TLS handshakes. Counter increases handle resets and are extrapolated estimates. Zero categories require observed closed-counter telemetry and both node scrapes UP; missing telemetry remains unavailable. Headline totals use this selected range but count TCP opens or failures; the pie counts completed records. They can differ for in-flight connections.

panels.title: Scope and independent evidence

options.content:
**Historical baseline — 2026-10-24, agent `f052d1276b`:** 6,000/6,000 HTTP 200 under mTLS load; 900/900 unenrolled attempts rejected. SPIRE outage: six retries, no false ACK, authenticated ACK after recovery. [Baseline outputs and pins](https://github.com/ephico2real2/clustermesh-trust-controller/blob/1c192a5ee84fb5218cb1385fdd9c5bf45ca69e1a/2026-10-24T0509Z-local-authenticated-only-f052d127/README.md).

**Selected range:** the live counter estimates above are separate from that baseline. Check the matching run report for deployed source/image pins, exact HTTP counts and independent identity/packet evidence.

**Native table:** lifetime counters, not range totals. `unknown` = no verified mesh principal; `DENY` = policy rejection; `-` = no failure flag. [Remaining acceptance: issue #8](https://github.com/ephico2real2/clustermesh-trust-controller/issues/8).

panels.description: Independent HTTP, identity, packet and retry checks supplement TCP metrics; links retain the remaining acceptance gates.

panels.title: How to read the connection totals and percentages
panels.description: Visible counter and percentage definitions; exact source and remaining security gates are below.

options.content:
**Selected range:** the three totals are counter increases, estimated across resets. Attempts without verified mTLS **include later DENY rejections**; never add DENY to attempts.

**Pie:** one destination record per **completed TCP attempt** in this range; five exclusive outcomes total 100%. In-flight connections and early unrecorded failures are excluded. No failure flag does not prove HTTP success. **TCP connections ≠ HTTP requests ≠ TLS handshakes.**

panels.title: mTLS TCP opens/s · both nodes (not TLS handshakes)
panels.description: TCP opens per second, rate over $__rate_interval, separately reported by the source and destination node. The two reports describe the same connections; do not add them. Solid blue is the receiving node, dashed red is the source. Missing data is unavailable; these are not TLS handshake counts.

panels.title: mTLS traffic · source-reported bytes/s
panels.description: Source-reported mTLS bytes sent plus received per second, rate over $__rate_interval. Red identifies cmtc-mtls-worker consistently with the TCP plot. Positive load produces a positive rate; zero means no measured payload, missing data is unavailable.

panels.title: Native TCP close verdicts and verified peer identities
panels.description: Last native TCP counter readings at the selected range end, split by node, reporter, verified principals and security. These are lifetime counters and can reset. Source and destination rows overlap; do not sum them. DENY means policy rejection, and a dash means no failure flag, not proven HTTP success.

panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**The four sections below preserve the original mTLS Performance, CA Trust and Rotation, Network Encryption and Security Violations dashboards.** Peer-identity failures appear once under TLS performance. Native TCP counters above do not replace actual TLS handshake metrics.

Planned counters use rates, gauges show latest levels/states, and TLS p95 requires actual handshake histogram buckets. Missing instrumentation is unknown, not zero.
